name: Treasure Hunt
introduction:
◆ Event Details ◆
● During the event period, consuming Trailblaze Power grants Treasure Hunt Tickets, up to a maximum of 100 Treasure Hunt Tickets can be obtained.
● Use Treasure Hunt Tickets to seek treasure and receive random rewards. Accumulating a certain number of treasure hunts will also grant Stellar Jade and Self-Modeling Resin rewards.
